program_name: M. Tech. IC Design and Technology
eligibility_criteria: B.E / B.Tech. in ECE, EEE / EIE, M.Sc. (Electronics, Applied Electronics), M.Sc. (Physics with specialisation in Electronics) (or) its equivalent degree in the above Disciplines with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Selection is conducted through a joint committee based on academic performance, technical aptitude, and research interest.
